content.text: I fixed `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 tests). The escaped-quote check in the quoted-field branch of `parse_csv_line` compared the next character to a single quote (`"'"`) instead of a double quote (`'"'`). A doubled `""` inside a quoted field therefore never counted as an escaped quote. The first `"` closed the field, and the second then raised "character after closing quote". I changed the comparison to `'"'`. I didn't run anything beyond the visible tests.
